newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S 100 METRES WORLD CHAMPION JONES.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S 100 METRES WORLD CHAMPION JONES.

text.p: Profile of Marion Jones, who won the world women's 100 metres title on Sunday:
A talented basketball player, she decided this year to concentrate on athletics with spectacular results.
At the U.S. championships last June in Indianapolis, she won the 100 metres in 10.97 seconds against the wind before beating Jackie Joyner-Kersee in the long jump.

Had already impressed in athletics a few years ago before turning to basketball, narrowly missing selection for 1991 world championships. Qualified for the Olympic relay squad in 1992 but declined selection.
